results.name: Ten unique initial events map to eight exact source identities
Read all preserves source business state and three distinct escalations
Required documents cannot be archived even for another source owner
Mixed required/routine archive is atomic and rejected
Routine archive is reversible and does not implicitly mark read
Personal read state and scope are independent
Unknown dates do not become on-time dates
Group read only captures existing events; new event remains unread
Duplicate refresh/new-event retry has one effect
Loading failures, partial reads and successful empty reads have distinct results
Cross-midnight quiet hours include start and exclude end
Same-day quiet hours and disabled quiet hours work
Invalid and ambiguous preferences are rejected
Delivery preview excludes read archived and unavailable targets
Email off cannot hide required notices or source obligations
Saved state validates exact fixture integrity without rewriting bad bytes
No universal business completion command exists
